newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON BEAT LIONS IN SUPER 12.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON BEAT LIONS IN SUPER 12.

text.p: Wellington beat Gauteng Lions (formerly known as Transvaal) 37-35 (half time 25-20) in the Super 12 match at Ellis Park on Saturday.
Scorers: Wellington: Tries - Christian Cullen 2, Jason O'Halloran. Conversions - Jon Preston 2, Penalties - Jon Preston 6.
Gauteng Lions: Tries - Joe Gillingham, Piet Krause, Dawie du Toit, Japie Mulder. Conversions - Gavin Johnson 3. Penalties - Gavin Johnson 3.
